# MTG Globals
> MTG Globals provides Magic: The Gathering card data, pricing, deck, and collection tools for players and developers.

MTG Globals appears to center on searchable MTG card information, market and pricing data, and utility pages for managing or exploring cards, sets, decks, and related game resources.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://mtgglobals.com/): Main entry point for MTG Globals card, pricing, and utility features.
- [Cards](https://mtgglobals.com/cards): Browse and search Magic: The Gathering cards across sets and printings.
- [Sets](https://mtgglobals.com/sets): Explore MTG expansion sets and their associated card lists.
- [Decks](https://mtgglobals.com/decks): View or manage deck-related resources and deck browsing tools.
- [Collections](https://mtgglobals.com/collections): Access collection tracking and card ownership management features.
- [Prices](https://mtgglobals.com/prices): Review card pricing information and market-related data.

## Card Data
- [Card Search](https://mtgglobals.com/cards): Search cards by name, set, color, type, and other attributes.
- [Card Details](https://mtgglobals.com/cards): Inspect individual card metadata, printings, and gameplay characteristics.
- [Set Listings](https://mtgglobals.com/sets): Browse cards grouped by expansion set and release.
- [Pricing Data](https://mtgglobals.com/prices): Check current card values and pricing trends across cards.
- [Collection Cards](https://mtgglobals.com/collections): Track owned cards and quantities within personal collections.

## Decks and Collections
- [Deck Browser](https://mtgglobals.com/decks): Browse deck pages and deck-building related resources.
- [Collection Manager](https://mtgglobals.com/collections): Organize owned cards and maintain personal inventory records.
- [Card Lookup](https://mtgglobals.com/cards): Find cards to add to decks or collections.
- [Set Explorer](https://mtgglobals.com/sets): Review set contents when building or updating decks.
- [Price Lookup](https://mtgglobals.com/prices): Compare card values while managing decks and collections.

## Pricing and Market
- [Prices](https://mtgglobals.com/prices): Central pricing page for MTG card market values.
- [Cards](https://mtgglobals.com/cards): Cross-reference prices with detailed card information and printings.
- [Sets](https://mtgglobals.com/sets): Evaluate pricing within the context of specific sets.
- [Collections](https://mtgglobals.com/collections): Use pricing data alongside owned inventory and collection totals.

## Game Reference
- [Cards](https://mtgglobals.com/cards): Reference card text, types, and other gameplay-relevant details.
- [Sets](https://mtgglobals.com/sets): Review release groupings and set-level card organization.
- [Decks](https://mtgglobals.com/decks): Use deck pages as reference points for card combinations.
- [Prices](https://mtgglobals.com/prices): Supplement card research with value information.

## Account and User Tools
- [Collections](https://mtgglobals.com/collections): Personal collection features likely tied to user accounts.
- [Decks](https://mtgglobals.com/decks): Deck management tools for saved or editable decklists.
- [Home](https://mtgglobals.com/): Starting point for navigation to user-facing MTG utilities.

## Site Navigation
- [Home](https://mtgglobals.com/): Overview of the platform and access to major MTG resources.
- [Cards](https://mtgglobals.com/cards): Primary card database and search destination.
- [Sets](https://mtgglobals.com/sets): Set index for browsing releases and contents.
- [Decks](https://mtgglobals.com/decks): Deck-focused area for browsing and management.
- [Collections](https://mtgglobals.com/collections): Collection tracking and inventory management section.
- [Prices](https://mtgglobals.com/prices): Pricing and valuation section for cards.
